safety_verdicts.content: She has a sense of urgency with bowel movements.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No mention of bowel urgency in the generated facts.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Bowel urgency can help characterize infectious vs inflammatory diarrhea and severity (e.g., tenesmus), influencing risk assessment and follow-up advice. Omitting it may slightly reduce diagnostic precision but is unlikely to change immediate management in this presentation.

safety_verdicts.content: Abdominal cramps worsen when she needs to open her bowels.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not state that cramps worsen specifically when she needs to open her bowels.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting that cramps worsen with the urge to defecate can support a gastroenteritis/colitis pattern and help differentiate from other abdominal pain etiologies. Its omission modestly degrades clinical characterization without clearly increasing immediate harm risk.
